hardware: Apple M5 Pro, 48 GiB unified memory

limitations: Small latency pilot on ten previously tested source excerpts from five papers; not a general accuracy benchmark.
Paper-scoped eight-candidate one-step selection with evidence read; no learned STOP or unrestricted multi-hop search.
Model and high reasoning effort follow the local CLI configuration, not necessarily this desktop conversation model.
Warm local selector is a service; each Codex path includes fresh CLI startup and remote model/tool/final-answer latency.
Known exact citation links are deliberately not used to choose candidates; production should use deterministic lookup first.
One run per agent arm; remote load, cache, and latency noise are not statistically controlled.

lifecycle.idle_test_method: Aged activity marker to exceed the unchanged production timeout

scope: Bounded English source-to-relationship selection; not unrestricted navigation or learned STOP/BACK.
